title_he: אֱלֹהִים הוּא אַהֲבָה, הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ יַגִּידוּ אַהֲבָתוֹ
review: 1:1–2 is the refrain alone as the printed first stanza (the same shape as tr0126/0180); it is kept unpadded so the hymn opens on the sentence the whole hymn repeats.
1:1 אֱלֹהִים הוּא אַהֲבָה — 1 John 4:8 (כִּי הָאֱלֹהִים הוּא אַהֲבָה); the article is kept on both nouns, as the verse has it, so the line is an identification and not a description.
3:1–2 חַיִּים בּוֹ וְנִתְקַיְּמָה — Acts 17:28 (כִּי־בוֹ אָנוּ חַיִּים וְנָעִים וְהֹוִים); נִתְקַיְּמָה is chosen for 'exist' so the verb stays a verb, rather than importing a philosophical noun.
4:2–3 לֹא תִתֹּם … לֹא נִדָּחֶה — Lam 3:22 (כִּי לֹא־תָמְנוּ רַחֲמֵי יְהוָה) with John 6:37 (אֶת־הַבָּא אֵלַי לֹא אֲגָרְשֶׁנּוּ); the two promises stay two clauses, as the Arabic keeps them.
5:2 נֶפֶשׁ הַחוֹטֵא — the Arabic نَفْسَ الْأَثِيم; נֶפֶשׁ is kept per the glossary for the whole living person, so the blood is given for the guilty one and not merely for his guilt.
